name: cc-hero
description: Guitar practice in a pane beside Claude Code: /hero scrolls a song past a now-marker as tablature and standard notation, Guitar Hero style, and scores what you play. With the microphone listener on (bun + ffmpeg, started by /hero mic on) it hears the guitar, judges each note's pitch and timing, and doubles as a tuner (/hero tune). Without it, space strums for timing practice. Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive terminal.
